text:
henry: kicking off staged rollout for ff:llm-adaptive-throttle at 23:40 UTC. aim: reduce burst queuing without harming fidelity. plan: micro(1%) -> infra-beta(5%) -> staged-1(20%) -> staged-2(50%). step interval 10m, soak 4m. runtime pinned to rtm-2.7.1 for the whole window.
maya: ack. which observables are stop vs pause?
zack: hard rollback if p95 increases > 60ms OR any OOM. pause if ANSWER_FIDELITY drops > 1.2x baseline for two consecutive soaks. customer error-rate >0.5% -> immediate rollback.
maria: (support-bot alias) putting rollout tag in release notes and notifying support channel.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: ff:llm-adaptive-throttle -> micro(1%), infra-beta(5%), staged-1(20%), staged-2(50%). start=1795555555 step=10m soak=4m pinned=rtn-2.7.1. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rls-712
henry: release-note snippet: "llm-adaptive-throttle: dynamic in-flight throttling to reduce burst latency; staged rollout pinned to runtime rtn-2.7.1. Watch p95 latency, ANSWER_FIDELITY, and OOMs."
zack: quick yank commands if needed:
```
# emergency global off
/feature toggle ff:llm-adaptive-throttle off --force
# roll a cohort down to 0
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-adaptive-throttle staged-2 0
# drain a cohort and tag samples for QA
/feature drain-cohort ff:llm-adaptive-throttle staged-1 --tag "drain-for-analysis"
```
oncall-bot: monitors created -> monitor/p95-throttle (60ms threshold, eval 5m) -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases. monitor/ooms critical. monitor/answer-fidelity-drop (1.2x) -> notify ML + this channel.
henry: decision flow: 1 alert -> pause any further ramp and start 25m investigation with sampled diffs. 2 alerts or any OOM -> rollback and open rollback ticket. keep runtime pinned until ML + eng signoff.
maya: if we pause, keep pin. mixed runtimes make telemetry noisy.
henry: agreed. also enable extra sampling for first 12m. tag odd outputs with #throttle-anom.
deploy-bot: micro cohort enabled (1%) at 1795555650. event: cohort->micro, pinned=rtn-2.7.1.
zack: sampling 400 outputs -> ANSWER_FIDELITY baseline=0.94 current=0.93, p95 delta +9ms. no OOMs.
maya: noise, but within expected. watching dashboards.
oncall-bot: heartbeat: no alerts.
henry: moving to infra-beta in 10m if no guardrail hits. @deploy-bot please post cohort events to thread.
deploy-bot: infra-beta enabled (5%) at 1795556250. event: cohort->infra-beta, pinned=rtn-2.7.1.
zack: running quick diff-run on prod-samples, will post aggregates every 4m.
maya: if infra-beta shows localized regression we can scale that cohort back to 0 and continue others. fallback route: route traffic to legacy variant rtn-2.6.x automatically if capacity or regressions persist.
support-bot: support reminder: change window closes at 01:20 UTC. if rollout stops mid-way, create rollback ticket and ping CSMs for any customer-facing incidents.
henry: small note for oncall: if you get customer reports, flag with incident tag "inc/llm-throttle" and drop a sample to #model-audit immediately.
zack: got it. starting extended sampling and will tag examples with #rollforward-candidate if they look better.
maya: thanks team. keep updates brief at each cohort change. :eyes:
